name: Rome Golf Cart Tour
overview: Experience Rome's historic sites and landmarks in comfort with a guided golf cart tour. This eco-friendly tour allows you to cover more ground than walking while avoiding the crowds and traffic of traditional bus tours.
history: Golf cart tours in Rome became popular as a sustainable alternative to large tour buses, providing intimate access to narrow streets and historic areas while reducing environmental impact. These tours have gained popularity for their personalized experience and ability to navigate Rome's ancient cobblestone streets.
highlights: Visit major sites including Colosseum, Forum, and Palatine Hill
Navigate narrow streets inaccessible to large buses
tips: Tours typically last 3-4 hours and cover 8-10 major sites. Book morning tours to avoid afternoon heat. Small group sizes (usually 6-8 people) ensure personalized attention. Some tours include skip-the-line entries to monuments.
